The '''Utegetu Nebula''' was a shell [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The Utegetu Nebula contained fourteen habitable worlds, including [[Woteba]], discovered in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. Under the terms of the [[Qoribu Truce]], these planets were settled by [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] nests. The [[Gorog|Dark Nest]] covertly colonized a fifteenth, unnamed planet orbiting the star [[Tusken's Eye]]. In [[36 ABY]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Fifth Fleet]] [[Blockade of the Utegetu Nebula|blockaded]] the nebula at the [[Murgo Choke]] to prevent the Killiks from migrating into [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] space and triggering a potential conflict; however, the [[Swarm War]] would still ensue, regardless.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' refers to it as the "Paradise Nebula."
